_doc: Oregon 3F wall lines, in the 3F image's own frame (u; layout.json frames map it to the world). Seeded from extracted.json by `npm run mapgen:import`, then curated by hand: every hand edit sets src "hand" (or "ulo") and a note. A line is HARD wherever no span covers it. tools/mapgen/DESIGN.md §4.
